'''B'ura B'an''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] militant who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. While traveling from the settlement of [[New Meen]] to the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Nabat/Legends|Nabat]], B'ura B'an was attacked by a gang of thugs in the employ of [[Teemo/Legends|Teemo]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]. During the fighting, B'ura B'an lost one of his [[Lekku/Legends|lekku]] to the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Trex]], who subsequently imprisoned B'ura B'an aboard his [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 freighter]], the ''[[Krayt Fang]]''. B'ura B'an was later released and returned to his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] by a group of adventurers.
